title: OpenChoreo ClusterAuthzRoleBinding
description: ClusterAuthzRoleBinding is the Schema for the clusterauthzrolebindings API

spec.description: ClusterAuthzRoleBindingSpec defines the desired state of ClusterAuthzRoleBinding

effect.description: Effect indicates whether this binding allows or denies access (default: allow)

entitlement.description: Entitlement defines the subject (from JWT claims) to grant the role to

claim.description: Claim is the JWT claim name (e.g., "groups", "sub", "email")

value.description: Value is the entitlement value to match

roleMappings.description: RoleMappings is the list of cluster roles this binding grants

items.description: ClusterRoleMapping pairs a role reference with an optional scope for cluster-scoped bindings

conditions.description:
Conditions define attribute-based restrictions on specific actions granted by the role.
Multiple entries whose actions match the request are combined with OR semantics —
at least one matching entry must pass for the action to be permitted.
If omitted, no attribute restrictions apply — the RBAC grant stands as-is.

items.description: AuthzCondition represents the conditions under which an action is allowed or denied in an authorization role.

actions.description:
Actions is the list of actions this condition applies to.
Supports exact match ("releasebinding:create") and wildcards ("releasebinding:*").

expression.description:
Expression is a CEL expression that must evaluate to true for the action to be permitted.
Examples:
  resource.environment in ["dev", "staging"]

roleRef.description: RoleRef references the ClusterAuthzRole to bind

kind.description:
Kind is the kind of role (AuthzRole or ClusterAuthzRole)
For AuthzRoleBinding: AuthzRole must be in the same namespace

name.description: Name is the name of the role

scope.description: Scope defines the target scope within the ownership hierarchy

component.description: Component scopes to a specific component (optional, requires project)

namespace.description: Namespace scopes to a specific namespace (optional)

project.description: Project scopes to a specific project (optional, requires namespace)

resource.description: Resource scopes to a specific resource (optional, requires project)
